We drop the parentheses and the addition sign to give 

$$
2+ (-6) = 2-6.
$$

 

Then, we move $6$ spaces to the left of $2$ on a number line.

![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/capture/linear/14149424/assets/ed6c51ffa37fa80ca17575c241738c602cb81cb2bca500fea1fb3231063763b2.png)

We end up at $-4.$ Therefore,

$$
2 + (-6) = -4.
$$
